data.name: Farzana
data.gender_notes: Farzana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who fulfills her duties and obligations towards Allah and her family. The name Farzana carries the meaning “One who Performs Obligations” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farzana usually hope their child will grow to embody one who performs obligations and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is obedient to Allah's commands.
data.etymology: Farzana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who Performs Obligations.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farzana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
